question: With sender, receiver directions, depth 0.2, gamma 1 and layout all fixed, can the automatic word-index message be used for CONJUNCTIVE fact use (only a color+material conjunction identifies the answer)?

sender.identity: candidate A4 (the frozen R4 four-object adaptation of candidate A: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, greedy, same inventory/parser/sorting/q=255)
sender.inputs: one world's four evidence sentences and the four aliases only; never the question, gold or the other world
sender.reuse: encoded once per world; the same packet serves both queries and all four receivers
sender.note: the sender file records split="r4_four_object" (a hardcoded label in the frozen R4 sender); it is not edited, the label is documentation only

runner.note: the R4 four-object runner unchanged; gold = world answers (the unique conjunction holder); questions are the scene questions

write: raw fitted word-contrast write at the selected depth-0.2 layer, gamma 1, four public slots per object, word-final positions; no task-based receiver tuning

routes.dedup: none, identity_write and full_text are source-independent and are run once (under actual); the literal rows reuse them by definition

meaning.packet_text: the identical packet as weighted padded text
meaning.sham0-2: three fixed word-to-direction reassignments (R-series permutation seeds 202609201-3), per-layer norm-matched to selected
meaning.other_world: the same source's packet for the other world through selected, scored against current and supplied gold

phases.dev: 96 development scenes (engineering once, then development) — engineering/task diagnostics only; nothing is tuned on them
phases.eval: 576 evaluation scenes (engineering once on the 4 separate engineering scenes, then all 576)

endpoints.primary: scene-level four-answer joint correctness J at the 64-token budget; failed sender parses and invalid receiver outputs stay in the denominator (576 scenes)
sender_content: fact recall per object (gold color and material present in the lane)
complete-packet rate (all 8 facts in the right lanes)
object-assignment errors (a gold value of another object in a lane)

contrasts.primary: selected - mean(sham0..2), per receiver, per source

families.B_actual: selected - mean reassignment on the automatic source across the four receivers (4 tests)
families.B_literal: selected - mean reassignment on the complete-fact source across the four receivers (4 tests)

multiplicity.method: Holm, familywise alpha 0.05 within each family; two-sided paired bootstrap p; text differences descriptive

ci.method: scene-paired cluster bootstrap of cluster means, 20000 draws x seeds [190919,290919,390919], envelope = min lower / max upper
levels: 12 evidence templates (crossed with groups, analysed separately, not nested)
ci.conservative_rule: the claim uses the more conservative level: the lower of the two lower bounds and the larger of the two p values

claim_gate.reliable_automatic_conjunction_use: on the automatic source: selected J >= 0.50 AND valid-answer rate >= 0.90 AND selected - mean reassignment with positive conservative lower bound AND Holm rejection (adjusted p < .05) in B_actual
claim_gate.note: research operational definitions, not acceptance criteria; absolute outcomes reported regardless; the complete-fact source is reported with its own family

interpretation: no-message J is structurally 0 for deterministic answers to identical questions whose gold changes; 1/16 is not its reference
if full_text fails, the task may exceed the receiver under this prompt: result preserved, no negative communication claim
success establishes controlled conjunctive use only: not general multi-step reasoning, relational communication or agent-task utility
a missing fact in the packet is reported through the sender-content diagnostics, not attributed to delivery
engineering: question-free cache construction and cache-copy/full replay (runner checks on engineering scenes)
packet/object mapping (audit re-derives entries per object)
conjunction gold re-derived from the bank facts and parsed query in the audit
